english.title: Operator of regulated public service vehicle operator when PSV used on road without accessibility / approval certificate
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the operator of a regulated public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX MARK..), which was used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..) when no accessibility or approval certificate had been issued in respect of that vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 176(3) and (4) of the Equality Act 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
operator of regulated public service vehicle
which was used on a road without either an accessibility or approval certificate

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In this section, 'Operator' has the same meaning as in the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 - section 176(6).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant was the operator of a regulated public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX MARK..) which was used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..) when no accessibility or approval certificate had been issued in respect of that vehicle.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
6 months
